---
name: verify
description: Prove or falsify a concrete implementation or behaviour claim with executable evidence. Use when testing, validating, or demonstrating that something works.
argument-hint: Describe the claim to prove
user-invocable: true
---

# Verify

Verify the requested claim.

Apply [test-and-verify](../test-and-verify/SKILL.md). Define observable acceptance criteria first, run the smallest high-signal check, broaden proportionately to risk, and report failed attempts and checks not run.
